text: Gold sculpture shows Cy and Mara under cut branches with Dee between them in the yard. The colony watches this joyful gathering on a clear evening. Bram, a tough courier, made the piece.

context.title: Cy and Mara
context.game_text: Cy and Mara are standing under a canopy of cut branches with Dee between them and the whole colony watching. The mood is joyful. This took place in the yard, on a clear evening. This image represents the events of the 11th of Septober, 5503.

tale.summary: Cy and Mara were married by Dee

text: Wood sculpture shows Bram and Kit on the barn roof as lightning splits the sky during a violent thunderstorm. The scene captures the frantic moment they hold the sheet down against the wind. Ana crafted the small sculpture with a kind hand.

Cy insulted Kit over the stolen rifle; by afternoon the two had come to blows in the courtyard and Dee had to stitch Kit.

text: I fear another confrontation over something trivial.
label: none
line: Morning chores done, time for something that tastes like actual sustenance.

context.trigger: You and Kit are in the courtyard again, the day after the fight.
context.speaker: Cy

text: I want them to leave so I can finish this work.
label: slight
line: Why are you in the workshop, um... you usually stick to the dining area.

context.trigger: Cy has just walked into the workshop where you are working.
context.speaker: Kit

text: I need her to understand the finality of this loss.
label: slight
line: Enough. The ground is still too soft.

context.trigger: Your brother Hale was buried this morning; Ana is standing beside you.
context.speaker: Dee

text: I worry about what he saw at the barricade.
label: kind
line: You alright, friend? Sit down, let me see if you need some stew.

context.trigger: Your son Tam has been quiet since the raid and is sitting by the stove.
context.speaker: Ana

text: I want her to think I'm not as rattled as I feel.
label: comfort
line: Um... just trying to manage the numbers, I suppose.

context.trigger: Your mother asks how you are holding up after the raid.
context.speaker: Tam

text: I fear the weight of this commitment more than the next meal.
label: comfort
line: This evening should conclude with a decent meal, we'll see.

context.trigger: You and Mara are about to be married; Kit is watching from the back.
context.speaker: Cy

text: I want her to stop watching me like I'm some stray animal.
label: none
line: Look. Just needed air, Ana. It costs nothing to walk out the door.

context.trigger: Ana asks why you were out of bed at night.
context.speaker: Bram

text: I worry about her not eating, but I don't want to push her.
label: kind
line: Dee you haven't touched a meal, friend. Eat something warm.

context.trigger: Dee has not eaten since the funeral and you are sitting across from her.
context.speaker: Mara

text: He was a good farmer, friend, who always kept his rows straight. Now we move on to work after this.
Hale was strong. Strong. He always held his ground when things got tough.
Mara, you are the best part of any meal we’ve ever had.
I will keep you safe, friend, through every harsh season.
